text: Hey guys. I got my A5 visa in April and then got my biometric T.Z. in May. I applied to join Bituach Leumi once I received my biometric T.Z. When I recieved my acceptance letter they informed me that I need to pay nearly a thousand shekels. I've been working a job which had me insured through them on my B1 visa and have been making payments to Bituach Leumi since November. Is this normal? Should I really owe them money? Thank you :)
